verdictEs: Icy Veins si quieres aprender una spec o entrar a un raid desde cero, con prosa exhaustiva-pero-accesible. Archon.gg si ya sabes jugar y quieres saber qué corre el top 1% esta semana sin leer 2 páginas de explicación — data agregada en lugar de prosa editorial.
verdictEn: Icy Veins to learn a spec or enter a raid from scratch, with exhaustive-but-accessible prose. Archon.gg if you already know how to play and want to know what the top 1% is running this week without reading 2 pages of prose — aggregated data instead of editorial prose.

useCases.reasonEn: Icy Veins explains the why behind every decision with pedagogical prose. A beginner reads and understands rotation, stat priority, talents in context. Archon shows what the top 1% plays without explaining why — useful only if you already have framework.
